strategic.rationale: Strategic is the heaviest weight (45%) in the bid-active regime becomes 35%; either way it's material. Engine -23 on the 'unusual discount' cohort P/E read. Instrument_transition_status remains 'unquantified_fear' — a bounded headwind (five of six force-feedback instrument lives extended → fewer replacement cycles) that the market is over-discounting. Trailing 40x P/E for a high-teens-recurring-growth compounder is the cheapest this has been in years on an absolute basis. This is a legitimate strategic buy. I don't go to -50 because the 2027 transition remains genuinely unquantified — I can't rule out management quantifying it as material — and 45% weight means strategic errors are expensive.
